name: sensei_task_answer_sure
description: Task answer_forge_question dispatches on sure confidence and gives the result directly
input:
use
  llm.reason

task answer_forge_question
  needs question: Text, context: Text
  gives Text
  do
    result = reason "You are forge-sensei. Using this prior knowledge:\n{context}\n\nAnswer this FORGE question: {question}"
    when result.sure -> give result
    when result.unsure -> give "Uncertain: {result}"
    else -> give "I could not answer this question confidently."

fn main
  result = answer_forge_question("What is a pure function?", "Pure functions have no side effects.")
  say result

mock_responses.text: A pure function in FORGE is a deterministic computation with no side effects.
